name: COG High-Risk Neuroblastoma Induction (Topotecan/Cyclophosphamide alternating with Cisplatin/Etoposide & Vincristine/Doxorubicin)

source.textbook: Principles and Practice of Pediatric Oncology, 8th ed.

institution.provenance: COG ANBL0032 / ANBL1531 High-Risk Neuroblastoma Induction Backbone

histology: neuroblastoma (high-risk: MYCN-amplified or metastatic age >= 18 months)

premedications.name: Aprepitant
premedications.notes: Triple antiemetic therapy for high-emetogenic cisplatin/cyclophosphamide cycles

supportiveCare: Hydration with D5 0.45% NS with 20 mEq KCl/L at 125-150 mL/m2/hr
Filgrastim (G-CSF) 5 mcg/kg/day SC starting 24-48 hours after each cycle until ANC > 1500/mcL post-nadir
Dexrazoxane cardioprotection at a 10:1 ratio with doxorubicin if cumulative dose reaches threshold
Audiometry baseline and every 2 cycles to monitor cisplatin ototoxicity
monitoring: CBC with differential twice weekly during nadir
BUN, creatinine, electrolytes, magnesium daily during cisplatin administration
Tumor response evaluation (CT/MRI, MIBG, marrow) after cycle 2 and cycle 5
clearanceChecks: Serum creatinine normal for age or GFR >= 70 mL/min/1.73m2

drugs.name: Topotecan
drugs.notes: Topotecan 1.2 mg/m2/day IV over 30 minutes on Days 1-5 (Cycles 1-2).

drugs.name: Cyclophosphamide
drugs.notes: Cyclophosphamide 400 mg/m2/day IV over 30 minutes on Days 1-5 (Cycles 1-2) with Mesna.

drugs.name: CISplatin
drugs.notes: CISplatin 50 mg/m2/day continuous IV infusion on Days 1-4 (total 200 mg/m2) with vigorous pre- and post-hydration (Cycles 3 and 5).

drugs.name: Etoposide
drugs.notes: Etoposide 200 mg/m2/day IV over 2 hours on Days 1-3 (Cycles 3 and 5).

drugs.name: vinCRIStine
drugs.notes: vinCRIStine 1.5 mg/m2 (hard cap 2.0 mg) IV push on Day 1 (Cycle 4). Fatal if given intrathecally. IV only.

drugs.name: DOXOrubicin
drugs.notes: DOXOrubicin 25 mg/m2/day continuous IV infusion on Days 1-3 (total 75 mg/m2, Cycle 4). Pediatric lifetime cumulative anthracycline cardiotoxicity guard applied (warn 250 mg/m2, hard 350 mg/m2).
